sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000025-P1, was presented by PFIZER (the Supplier) to Sunrise Care Partners 025 on February 10, 2026.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 2 rebate of 3.5%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Pneumococcal share floor of 60%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: declined by the Customer.
